cost_gate.action_rule: Do not upgrade unless expected swing edge exceeds both cost and minimum edge gates.
cost_gate.same_theme_peer_rule: Do not upgrade unless same-theme best-peer evidence passes.
cost_gate.market_regime_rule: Do not upgrade when the market proxy is above the action range limit.

cost_gate.symbol_adverse_rule: Do not upgrade symbols with a recent adverse-breach risk tag; keep them watch-only until evidence improves.

action_tier_policy.formal_actionable: All hard gates pass; research-only and no automatic execution.
action_tier_policy.manual_probe: Core technical, edge/cost, liquidity, market, symbol-risk, and peer gates pass; only compatible soft nontechnical evidence blockers remain, and human confirmation is required.
action_tier_policy.observe: Track without action when the symbol has watch value but lacks formal or manual-probe readiness.
action_tier_policy.suspended: Do not initiate while quote freshness, formal evidence, cost/edge, volume, symbol-risk, peer, or event-risk gates are unresolved; this is not a chase-specific verdict.
action_tier_policy.blocked: Do not chase when limit-up or overextended market-position blockers are present.
